video_prompt: One continuous vertical phone video, full frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The woman — a Black woman about 34 years old with medium-dark skin and shoulder-length natural curls, wearing a plain oatmeal knit sweater and black leggings — sits alone, sitting on the front edge of a low grey fabric sofa in a bright modern apartment living room with a large window, sheer curtains, a floor lamp, a potted fiddle-leaf fig and light oak floor, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same seat, same distance from the camera. Handheld-steady phone on a tripod, the camera stays still; the room around her stays still. She talks straight into the camera, serious and caring, like warning a friend, with small natural head movements; her hands stay clasped near her knees with small gestures.
